REMOVAL OF DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER

1. REMOVE STABILIZER BRACKET

2. REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER NO. 1 MOUNTING BOLT NUTS

3. DISCONNECT DRIVE SHAFT FROM DIFFERENTIAL

4. REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL CARRIER BOLTS

5. REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER
(a) Remove the No. 2 mounting bolt nuts and lower stopper.
(b) Remove the differential support member with the upper stopper.
